action.description: Create a wake, list this conversation's wakes, or cancel one by ID.

name.description: Short human-readable name. Required for create.

prompt.description: Instruction your future turn should act on. Required for create.

after_seconds.description: Wake after this many seconds. Preferred for relative delays. Cannot be combined with scheduled_at or cron.

scheduled_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with Z or an explicit UTC offset. Cannot be combined with after_seconds or cron.

cron.description: Recurring five-field cron expression interpreted in UTC. Minimum interval is 1 hour. Cannot be combined with after_seconds or scheduled_at.

id.description: Wake ID returned by create or list. Required for cancel.
